name: cs-navigator
description: Route capability-selection questions to the smallest evidence-backed ChatGPT Skills set, or say when no skill is needed.

interface.longDescription: Describe what you want to accomplish and CS Navigator routes capability-selection questions to the smallest useful evidence-backed skill set. It stays out of the way when no skill is needed, separates discovery from trust evidence, and reports real coverage gaps instead of inventing capabilities.
defaultPrompt: Find the smallest useful skill set for this goal, or tell me if no additional skill is needed.
Check whether this external skill has enough evidence to trust.
